original_question: Which class of drugs is commonly prescribed to manage androgen-related symptoms in women with Achard–Thiers syndrome?

final_qi.question: Which class of drugs is commonly prescribed to manage androgen-related symptoms in women with Achard–Thiers syndrome?
final_qi.search_keyword: Achard Thiers syndrome drugs manage androgen-related symptoms women
final_qi.long_answer: Women with Achard–Thiers syndrome often exhibit androgen-related symptoms such as hirsutism and acne. To manage these symptoms, anti-androgen drugs are commonly prescribed. These medications work by blocking the effects of androgens at their receptor sites, thus reducing the likelihood and severity of these symptoms. Anti-androgen therapies are a standard component of treatment regimens, especially in cases of androgen excess as seen in conditions related to Achard–Thiers syndrome.
